comparison.case_id: <vector_section>/<case_id from the canonical vector or Golden fixture bundle>
comparison.case_classes: The exact sorted unique class list declared by case_contract for that vector section and case.
comparison.result_encoding: Every case emits deterministic result bytes. Successful byte-producing cases emit the computed bytes directly. Classifications, expected errors and state transitions emit RFC 8785 canonical JSON bytes of the observed result object.
comparison.result_base64: RFC 4648 standard base64 with padding over exact result bytes
comparison.result_sha256: sha256:<lowercase SHA-256 of exact result bytes>
comparison.reports: After removing implementation and implementation_version, Go and TypeScript reports have byte-identical RFC 8785 canonical JSON.

result_byte_contract.canonical_envelopes: Exact RFC 8785 canonical Envelope hash-input bytes after independent Source mapping; integrity.envelope_hash remains absent.
result_byte_contract.idempotency: Exact domain separator plus LP_UTF8 identity input bytes.
result_byte_contract.decimal_strings: RFC 8785 canonical JSON of {"valid":<boolean>,"value":<exact input string>}.
result_byte_contract.timestamps: RFC 8785 canonical JSON of {"normalized":<exact normalized string>,"valid":true} for valid cases, otherwise {"error_code":<exact code>,"valid":false}.
result_byte_contract.unicode: RFC 8785 canonical JSON of {"utf8_hex":<lowercase exact UTF-8 hex>,"valid":<boolean>} for valid opaque Source values; protocol-controlled cases use {"valid":<boolean>}.
result_byte_contract.replay: RFC 8785 canonical JSON of the vector object with case_id removed and remaining keys unchanged.

envelope_validation_sequence: strictly parse Source and shared Golden inputs with duplicate-key rejection
map Source facts and compare the complete hash-input object to the exact Golden hash input
canonicalize the hash input with integrity.envelope_hash absent
validate the final Event Envelope and referenced Domain Payload
remove integrity.envelope_hash and reproduce the exact canonical Golden hash input
